name: 33035 · Homestead, FL
findings: ZIP 33035 (Homestead) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33035 (Homestead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
